answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the velvet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A kernel of per-task receipts records who did what, and the spiral of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
